originality.rationale: The paper arXiv:2601.20077v3 supplies a complete exact low-order hierarchy, averaged empirical density covariance, and spectral form factor but not a conditional full empirical-measure limit as a random mixture of infinitely many Gaussian variances. The present probabilistic fixed-fraction common-clock limit determines all bounded spatial observables jointly and yields a non-self-averaging spatial second moment. Earlier simultaneous-reset and local-reset thermodynamic theories do not cover uniformly randomly sampled interior batches, while weighted-exponential perpetuity/small deviation statements in isolation are acknowledged prior mathematics.
